regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: DOS EXE header; entry 0000:0100 and no stack, as a tiny-model program has.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 10 addresses inside Borland's math library that DOS fills in at load time.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Fills the header to a 16-byte boundary.

regions.label: Program prefix space
regions.note: Tiny-model programs start at offset 100h; DOS puts the program prefix here at load time.

regions.label: Turbo C++ startup (c0t)
regions.note: Tiny-model start-up: code, data and stack share one segment, then main() is called.

regions.label: His drawing routines
regions.note: Refresh wait, DOS memory, run-length decoder, plane copy, curtain and fly-in: C functions with inline assembly.

regions.label: Arabic name picture
regions.note: Packed picture, 640 by 58 pixels: بورسعيد للحاسبات, 9,400 bytes.

regions.label: Show the English name
regions.note: Points at the next picture through CS and draws it.

regions.label: English name picture
regions.note: Packed picture, 448 by 33 pixels: PORT-SAID COMPUTER SYSTEMS, 5,574 bytes.

regions.label: Fly in the logo
regions.note: Turns four code addresses into far pointers and flies the four logo tiles in.

regions.label: main() and the sign-off
regions.note: Sets EGA mode 10h, plays the three scenes, waits for a key, then the YASSER DOT DESIGN sign-off from NAMES.COM.

regions.label: Math library vectors
regions.note: Room for the 11 interrupt vectors Borland's math library uses (34h to 3Eh).

regions.label: Floating-point emulator and Turbo C runtime
regions.note: Borland's decimal math for the fly-in's straight lines, done in software on PCs without a math chip, plus the C runtime.

regions.label: Runtime data
regions.note: Turbo C++ copyright, floating-point error messages and runtime tables.

routines.name: retrace_delay
routines.note: Waits n screen refreshes by reading port 3DAh.

routines.name: dos_alloc
routines.note: Asks DOS for memory to unpack a picture into (INT 21h AH=48h).

routines.name: rle_decode
routines.note: The NAMES.COM run-length loop, byte for byte, inside a C function.

lines.note: add si,4: skips the new width and height header
From here on, identical to NAMES.COM 08A3

routines.name: plane_copy
routines.note: Copies a strip into each of the four color layers in turn (Map Mask 1, 2, 4, 8).

routines.name: fly_in
routines.note: Moves a picture on a straight line in 100 steps, with decimal math.

routines.name: main
routines.note: Mode 10h, the logo, ten refreshes, the two names, a key, text mode, the sign-off.

routines.name: sign_off
routines.note: The NAMES.COM signature and spark, rewritten in C with inline assembly.
